frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Three methods compete for MC Greek estimation: finite-difference bumping (bias O(h²), variance O(1/h²)); pathwise differentiation (unbiased, low variance, requires smooth payoff); likelihood-ratio method (unbiased, supports any payoff, higher variance). Pathwise is the default; LR is the universal fallback for discontinuous payoffs (digital, barrier).
